description: Discover our 100% Arabica Medium Roast, crafted with care in small batches to ensure the utmost quality. This blend produces an exceptionally bright cup, perfectly balanced with a beautiful hint of sweetness. name: Travel Series - Coffee Concentrate
description: Brown Rush Coffee’s Travel Series Coffee Concentrate is your go-to brew, crafted from 100% Arabica beans and designed to be your perfect travel companion. With a shelf life of 9 months and no preservatives, it delivers rich, fresh flavor whenever you need it. Whether you're on the road or at home, enjoy exceptional coffee that’s ready when you are—no boarding pass required!

name: Brown rush starter pack
description: This coffee concentrate starter pack is like a rock band with three distinct personalities. Robusta is the edgy lead singer, Arabica is the smooth bassist, and the 80-20 blend is the perfect drummer - just the right balance of punch and finesse. Get 200 ml of each of these bad boys!

name: Bullet coffee concentrate
description: Bullet coffee concentrate is a perfectly balanced brew of Arabica and Robusta - nuanced taste of Arabica with a captivating strength of Robusta. With its medium dark roast and 80-20 blend, it will elevate your coffee moments to a new height.

name: Spear coffee concentrate
description: Our medium roast coffee concentrate - Spear - is like the Goldilocks of coffee, not too light, not too dark, just right for your taste buds. And with its concentrated delicious flavor, you can brew a delightful and luxurious coffee with ease.

name: Bazooka coffee concentrate
description: Our coffee concentrate, dark roast 100% Robusta, is like a shot of pure coffee adrenaline - it'll kick your taste buds into high gear and have you ready to take on the world (or at least your morning commute). So grab a bottle and get ready to feel like a coffee superhero!
